buyExact(uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: The caller pays quote and receives both the Hana and the sell-back quota.

quoteSell(uint256).notice: Public curve price only. A sale additionally requires the caller's own quota.

releaseStartedAt().notice: Canonical release start: issuer early-release time if triggered, else migration time.

sellable(address).notice: Amount the account can sell back right now: min(quota, wallet balance), 0 when closed.

startEarlyRelease().notice: One-time, irreversible issuer trigger; only for issuances frozen with earlyReleaseAllowed.
